transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: Morning. Andre and Luis are out today, so it's us. Lin.

transcript.speaker: p-lin

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: Good.

transcript.speaker: p-zoe
transcript.text: fixtures. the load cell is mounted on the knee rig, uh, temporarily, with the old bracket. it's not great but it works for now

transcript.speaker: p-lin
transcript.text: Does the temporary mount move under load? I don't want to chase a fake signal.

transcript.text: i don't think so. probably not. i'll put an indicator on it

transcript.text: I'll check it after this.

transcript.text: The question is where the build kits are. One, the carts arrived. Two, I'm labeling them today. Three, I'm, uh, still missing a few things from the kitting list, which I'm chasing.

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: Fine.

transcript.speaker: p-zoe
transcript.text: oh, also, the chamber, the door seal is torn on one corner. it still holds temp, mostly

transcript.speaker: p-lin

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: Put a ticket in. Next.

transcript.text: Can we get more of the heat shrink in the small size? We're almost out 😬

transcript.text: ill look on the shelf

transcript.text: Okay. My list. We need FLEXSPLINE CLAMP by 11/12. 6 of them. Nora, Zoe, whoever. Somebody own it.

transcript.text: i can, i think. i'll check what's in the system

transcript.speaker: p-nora
transcript.text: The question is whether there's a drawing. If Zoe sends me the drawing, I'll get it out.

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: And that order. Just 1. We need it by 11/6. Is it worth expediting? I don't know. Nora, find out what it costs.

transcript.speaker: p-nora
transcript.text: So the question is expedite or not. I'll get a number and we can decide. I don't want to pay for it if we don't need it on 11/6 exactly.

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: We need it by 11/6.

transcript.speaker: p-nora

transcript.text: Will do.

transcript.speaker: p-lin
transcript.text: Sorry, was the dyno plate date 11/10 or 11/12? I wrote both down.

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: Plate 11/10. Clamp 11/12.

transcript.speaker: p-lin
transcript.text: Thanks.

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: Okay. Go.
